modules.title: Hardware and distributed compute
modules.scope: Scheduling, hardware use, storage, and fault recovery.
modules.verification: Run the same checked workload with less time, cost, or energy. Count retries and failures.

modules.title: Compilers and numerical software
modules.scope: Compilers, kernels, memory layouts, and numerical precision.
modules.verification: Pass reference correctness tests. Show speed or memory gains on real workloads and named hardware.

modules.title: Training data
modules.scope: Data collection, cleaning, labels, coverage, and data origins.
modules.verification: Improve unseen-task results at equal training compute. Check data rights and test contamination.

modules.title: Environments and curricula
modules.scope: Simulators, task generators, learning order, and rewards.
modules.verification: Check rewards for exploits. Show learning transfers to separately made tasks.

modules.title: Model structures
modules.scope: Attention, recurrence, expert routing, representations, and world models.
modules.verification: Compare capability at equal training and inference budgets. State the tested model sizes.

modules.title: Pretraining and optimization
modules.scope: Training objectives, optimizers, schedules, and stability.
modules.verification: Reach a fixed capability with fewer resources. Include failed runs and repeat measurements.

modules.title: Post-training
modules.scope: Instruction tuning, reinforcement learning, feedback, and reward models.
modules.verification: Improve independent task results. Evaluate with a method separate from the training reward.

modules.title: Inference and serving
modules.scope: Quantization, caching, batching, and adaptive compute.
modules.verification: Measure quality, cost, memory, and latency on fixed workloads. Include slow requests.

modules.title: Knowledge access
modules.scope: Search, document parsing, retrieval, citations, and grounding.
modules.verification: Check retrieved evidence and final answers on unseen information. Report each result separately.

modules.title: Memory and continual learning
modules.scope: Persistent memory, feedback, adaptation, and retention.
modules.verification: Improve long task sequences. Measure forgetting, false memory, and poisoned input.

modules.title: Reasoning and planning
modules.scope: Search, plans, program generation, and proof construction.
modules.verification: Check executable solutions, proofs, or final outcomes. Count all attempts within a fixed budget.

modules.title: Tool use and action
modules.scope: Software tools, browsers, computer use, and robot interfaces.
modules.verification: Check final outcomes, recovery, and permissions in varied environments. A transcript alone is insufficient.

modules.title: Agent coordination
modules.scope: Delegation, routing, shared state, and cooperation in the system under study.
modules.verification: Compare with a strong single-agent baseline. Count communication, extra calls, and human help.

modules.title: Autonomous research
modules.scope: Hypotheses, experiment design, implementation, and result analysis.
modules.verification: Reproduce useful findings independently. Measure accepted outcomes per total resource budget.

modules.title: Evaluation and verification
modules.scope: Benchmarks, graders, statistics, and contamination checks.
modules.verification: Detect known defects. Reproduce results. Test whether scores predict success on independent tasks.

modules.title: Reliability, alignment, and security
modules.scope: Constraint following, uncertainty, prompt injection, containment, and interpretability.
modules.verification: Reduce measured failures while retaining useful capability. Make testable claims with clear limits.

modules.title: Project tools and reproducibility
modules.scope: Task formats, contribution tools, result records, and integration.
modules.verification: Let another person reproduce the result. Reduce the work needed to review and integrate useful changes.
